description: New Zealand v0 pre-calibration references: destination distributions for the transport quantile maps (earnings, rents, liquid assets), territorial-authority population for the atomic geography support, and the MSD recipient counts that calibrate the take-up draws (MC6). They are read before weight calibration and are kept apart from target_references.json so that adding a calibration target does not re-run transport. Every row is an unactivated placeholder.

target_references.name: ird_wage_salary_people_by_band
target_references.notes: IRD wage and salary bands are the destination distribution for the employment-income quantile map (MC4), not a weight-calibration target. Each band needs a destination-NZD indicator and source-period bridge.

target_references.name: mbie_bond_rents_by_territorial_authority

metadata.publisher: Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment

target_references.notes: MBIE tenancy bond rents by territorial authority, bedrooms and dwelling type (targets doc H3) are the destination distribution for the within-region rent quantile map. Chronicle pins the month and records whether the rents describe newly lodged bonds or the active stock; that evidence decides scenario S4. Period is null until the harvest pins the month.

target_references.name: stats_nz_household_financial_net_worth_distribution
target_references.notes: Stats NZ household net worth statistics, financial-asset distribution: the destination for the household-level liquid-asset quantile map (MC10a); members are rescaled pro rata and the unit sum feeds the Accommodation Supplement cash-asset test. The Chronicle package does not yet exist (6 Oct plan B6 part 2). Period is null until the release vintage is named.

target_references.name: stats_nz_population_by_territorial_authority
target_references.notes: Territorial-authority resident population (targets doc S7) builds the population-weighted territorial authority by Accommodation Supplement area support with as_area_crosswalk.json. It is a support weight, not a weight-calibration target.

target_references.name: msd_main_benefit_recipients_by_program_age
target_references.notes: Count-only administrative cells constrain an explicit receipt/take-up layer. They must never be bound to Axiom full-entitlement outputs or used to force entitlement dollars to equal actual expenditure.

target_references.name: msd_nz_super_veterans_pension_recipients
target_references.notes: Recipient stock is a receipt-state target, not an entitlement-output target. Expenditure is validation evidence and stays outside the calibration manifest.
